v2_chk_billing_usage_attempts_result.name: v2_chk_billing_usage_attempts_result
v2_chk_billing_usage_attempts_result.value: ("v2"."billing_usage_attempts"."status" = 'error' AND "v2"."billing_usage_attempts"."error_message" IS NOT NULL AND "v2"."billing_usage_attempts"."response" IS NULL) OR ("v2"."billing_usage_attempts"."status" <> 'error' AND "v2"."billing_usage_attempts"."error_name" IS NULL AND "v2"."billing_usage_attempts"."error_message" IS NULL)

v2_chk_cron_jobs_session_context.name: v2_chk_cron_jobs_session_context
v2_chk_cron_jobs_session_context.value: "v2"."cron_jobs"."session_id" IS NULL OR "v2"."cron_jobs"."space_id" IS NOT NULL

v2_chk_labels_hierarchy.name: v2_chk_labels_hierarchy
v2_chk_labels_hierarchy.value: ("v2"."labels"."parent_id" is null and "v2"."labels"."depth" = 0) or ("v2"."labels"."parent_id" is not null and "v2"."labels"."depth" = 1)

v2_chk_spaces_slug_format.name: v2_chk_spaces_slug_format
v2_chk_spaces_slug_format.value: "v2"."spaces"."slug" is null or (length("v2"."spaces"."slug") between 1 and 80 and "v2"."spaces"."slug" !~ '[^a-z0-9_-]' and left("v2"."spaces"."slug", 1) ~ '[a-z0-9]' and right("v2"."spaces"."slug", 1) ~ '[a-z0-9]')

v2_chk_user_channels_credential_envelope.name: v2_chk_user_channels_credential_envelope
v2_chk_user_channels_credential_envelope.value:
coalesce(
        jsonb_typeof("v2"."user_channels"."credential_envelope") = 'object'
        and "v2"."user_channels"."credential_envelope"->'version' = '1'::jsonb
        and "v2"."user_channels"."credential_envelope"->>'algorithm' = 'aes-256-gcm'
        and "v2"."user_channels"."credential_envelope"->>'keyId' ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$'
        and "v2"."user_channels"."credential_envelope"->>'nonce' ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16}$'
        and "v2"."user_channels"."credential_envelope"->>'authTag' ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$'
        and "v2"."user_channels"."credential_envelope"->>'ciphertext' ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,}$',
        false
      )

v2_chk_works_slug_format.name: v2_chk_works_slug_format
v2_chk_works_slug_format.value: length("v2"."works"."slug") between 1 and 80 and "v2"."works"."slug" !~ '[^a-z0-9_-]' and left("v2"."works"."slug", 1) ~ '[a-z0-9]' and right("v2"."works"."slug", 1) ~ '[a-z0-9]'
